_comment: Local-machine safeguard for the dispatched-worker full-suite stall.
This file is a TEMPLATE. It cannot live in enforced form in the repo because
.claude/settings.local.json is git-ignored local config. Paste the 'hooks'
block below into your own .claude/settings.local.json (merge with any hooks
you already have). It denies backgrounding or Monitoring a test-suite run so
there is no path back to the stall; the intended command is a blocking
The matcher fires on Monitor, and on Bash calls that request run_in_background,
when the command text mentions unittest / pytest / run_tests_sharded.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys,re; d=json.load(sys.stdin); ti=d.get('tool_input',{}); tn=d.get('tool_name',''); cmd=ti.get('command','') or ti.get('shellCommand','') or json.dumps(ti); bg=bool(ti.get('run_in_background')); hit=re.search(r'unittest|pytest|run_tests_sharded|-m[ ]+unittest', cmd); block=(tn=='Monitor' and hit) or (tn=='Bash' and bg and hit); print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PreToolUse','permissionDecision':'deny','permissionDecisionReason':'Run the test suite as a blocking foreground `python scripts/run_tests_sharded.py` -- do not background it or Monitor it (FRICTION_LOG 2026-09-03).'}}) if block else '{}')"
